summary: FERC dismisses Eolian's request for rehearing or clarification of the CAISO show cause order. It finds the show cause order is not a final order, and declines to give guidance while the proceeding is in abeyance until November 16, 2026.

points.point: Eolian asked that electrically proximate generation be allowed permanent load-limited generator interconnection service.
points.quote: electrically proximate generation may access permanent load-limited generator interconnection service where it is equally capable of enabling the large load to limit its withdrawals

points.point: Eolian also asked that CAISO be required to show its reforms open a pathway for significant generating capacity to take load-limited interconnection.
points.quote: must be paired with an obligation for CAISO to show that the reforms will enable a pathway for significant generating capacity to provide load-limited interconnection.

points.point: FERC says the show cause order made no final determination, only a preliminary finding that the tariffs appear unjust and unreasonable.
points.quote: The Commission determined only that the tariffs appear to be unjust, unreasonable, and unduly discriminatory or preferential and instituted an FPA section 206 show cause proceeding

points.point: FERC dismisses the clarification request and gives no guidance during the abeyance.
points.quote: We do not intend to provide clarification or guidance with respect to the Show Cause Order while the show cause proceeding is held in abeyance.

points.point: FERC restates that responses are due November 16 and answers December 16, 2026.
points.quote: responses to the Show Cause Order will be due on November 16, 2026, and answers to responses will be due on December 16, 2026.

throughLine.text: Disposes of a rehearing request against the E-10 CAISO show cause order and confirms the August 14 abeyance, leaving responses due November 16, 2026.
